'''catman421 Newbie Decks (MISC)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[catman421]]
* '''Published:''' 27 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Jabba's Palace: Lower Passages|JPSD-D-jabbaspalacelowerpassages.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Jabba's Palace: Lower Passages
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 Jabba's Palace Lower Passages catma.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

No, I'm not a newbie, but these decks are a pair that I built for demoing and basic newbie instruction.  Tell me what you think.

The published list has 40 cards.

The published post has two decks. This dest is the Dark list (Deck 1).

== Strategy ==

Basically, these decks are designed to be simple enough for somebody who has never played before to be able to pick up the deck and play (with instruction of course).  Just about every card in each deck has an equal counterpart in the other deck.  Suggestions are welcome.
